trigger: Night on the Dixie Valley road. The truck stalls. First Tallman fight (enc_ch07_road_tallman).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Forty miles of washboard road. The truck dies three miles short of the fence. Fuel filter. Of course.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [On her feet in the truck bed. Not growling. Shaking. Staring into the dark.]

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Lights. Every light you have. Now. They don't like light. They like heat. The engine block is a beacon.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Something moves at the edge of the headlights. Close this time. Long arms. It's coming low and fast.

choices.text: [Everyone in the cab. Lights on. Wait]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The flare turns the night red. It stops, flinches, screams without sound. You fire. It goes down. It gets up. It runs.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's wounded and limping into the dark beyond the flare.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You find it in a dry wash, two hundred yards out. It takes four more shots. It dies like an animal. Quietly.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: [Kneeling by it, very still] A-4. I named her Tamsin. She learned to open her hold latch in March. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: It'll remember the flare. They remember. Next time it'll come from the dark side.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Five hours in a cold cab with every light on. Twice, something walks around the truck. At dawn there are tracks.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Dawn. The Annex fence is a silver line on the flats. A guard shack. A light in the guard shack window.
